notes.title: VIRTUE 2.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
VIRTUE 2.2.0 Updates:


The JSON 3D model file format now supports 'sphereoid' components.
Improved lighting for FBX files.
Included an FBX file of the ePIC detector with a school bus next to it for scale.
The fly speed in the Oculus version of VIRTUE can now be adjusted.
Added a 'smooth turning' mode in the Oculus version of VIRTUE.
The proper method for rendering SketchUp files is now described in the manual.
Other various bug fixes.

notes.title: VIRTUE 2.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
VIRTUE 2.1.0 Updates:


 Users can now upload FBX files to be displayed in the application via TriLib 2
 EIC detector menagerie model has been updated with better textures, and can now be expanded
 The menu has been entirely redesigned to be more organized and animated
 More customization is available for the particles that are animated before an event
 Grid menu has been added to the Oculus version of VIRTUE
 Other minor code improvements
 New logo!
